अजय देवगन के फैंस के लिए आई है बहुत बड़ी खुशखबरी! 🔥

नॉर्थ अमेरिका (USA और Canada) के बॉक्स ऑफिस पर 2 अक्टूबर 2026 को रिलीज हुई फिल्म Drishyam 3 ने तहलका मचा दिया है।

अभिषेक पाठक के डायरेक्शन में बनी इस क्राइम थ्रिलर फिल्म ने 26 दिनों में 6.71 million dollar (63.88 करोड़ रुपये) का रिकॉर्ड तोड़ कलेक्शन कर लिया है।

यह कमाई Drishyam 2 के 3.7 million dollar के कलेक्शन से 81.35% यानी 3.01 million dollar ज्यादा है। 🚀

इतना ही नहीं, इस फिल्म ने Singham Again के 4.6 million dollar के कलेक्शन को पीछे छोड़ दिया है। 💥

अब Drishyam 3 नॉर्थ अमेरिका के बॉक्स ऑफिस पर अजय देवगन की सबसे ज्यादा कमाई करने वाली नंबर 1 फिल्म बन चुकी है। ✨

ctx.title: Drishyam 3 North America Box Office: Earns 81% More Than Drishyam 2, Emerging As A Big Hit!
ctx.summary:
Drishyam 3 has emerged as Ajay Devgn's biggest hit at the North American box office, grossing $6.7 million+ in 26 days. 
 The post  Drishyam 3 North America Box Office: Earns 81% More Than Drishyam 2, Emerging As A Big Hit!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Drishyam 3 has performed beyond expectations at the North American box office (USA and Canada). Given the franchise’s brand value, the film was expected to do well, but it exceeded initial projections and became a big hit. Compared with its predecessor, Drishyam 2, the film is ahead by a huge margin. While collections have now slowed down, the film has reached a hefty total in a span of 26 days. Keep reading for a detailed report!
As per the recent collection update, the Bollywood crime thriller grossed $23K on its fourth Tuesday, day 26. Overall, it has amassed a whopping $6.71 million at the North American box office. It equals 63.88 crore in Indian rupees. It’s an impressive number for the crime thriller genre!
For those who don’t know, Drishyam 2 was a good success story in the territory with a lifetime collection of $3.7 million . In comparison, Drishyam 3 has earned $6.71 million , which is a difference of $3.01 million . Calculated further, the threequel is ahead with a whopping 81.35% higher earnings. So, it could be said that the film took the Drishyam franchise’s box-office performance to the next level.
With a solid $6.71 million in the kitty, Drishyam 3 is already Ajay Devgn’s highest-grossing film in North America by a big margin. It surpassed Singham Again ( $4.6 million ) to claim the top spot.

Drishyam 3 is directed by Abhishek Pathak and produced by Kumar Mangat Pathak, Abhishek Pathak, Ajit Andhare, and Alok Jain under the banner of Panorama Studios and Star Studio18. The film also stars Jaideep Ahlawat, Tabu, Rajat Kapoor, Kamlesh Sawant, Shriya Saran, Ishita Dutta, Mrunal Jadhav, and Prakash Raj in key roles. It was theatrically released on October 2, 2026.
